First release of Rflap: JFLAP 7.1 ported to Rust, usable from AI chats and agents.

## Downloads

| System | File |
|---|---|
| Windows (x64) | `rflap-0.1.0-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` |
| Linux (x64) | `rflap-0.1.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `rflap-0.1.0-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Intel) | `rflap-0.1.0-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |

Each archive has `rflap` (CLI and web editor: `rflap gui`), `rflap-mcp` (MCP server for ChatGPT,
Claude, Claude Code and Codex), the integration guides in `docs/integrations/`, and the agent skill
in `skills/rflap/`. Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

The binaries are not signed: Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation ("More info → Run anyway"),
and on macOS run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine rflap rflap-mcp` once.

## What is in it

- Every JFLAP 7.1 environment: finite automata, pushdown automata, single and multi-tape Turing
  machines with building blocks, Mealy and Moore machines, grammars (type test, λ/unit/useless
  removal, CNF, brute force, LL(1), SLR(1), CYK and user-controlled parsing), regular expressions,
  L-systems, and the regular and context-free pumping lemma games.
- All JFLAP conversions (NFA→DFA, minimization, FA↔RE, FA↔regular grammar, CFG→PDA LL/LR,
  PDA→CFG, TM→unrestricted grammar), `.jff` files of every type, and the JFLAP layouts.
- Checked against the real JFLAP 7.1 jar: grammar tables, conversions, L-systems, pumping lemmas
  and `.jff` files give the same results.
- Design from a language: an AI turns the exercise into a formal spec; Rflap builds the minimal
  automaton, explains every state and verifies it with examples.
- Interactive widget inside Claude and ChatGPT (MCP Apps); Markdown tables and a local viewer link
  in Claude Code and Codex.

## En español

Rflap es JFLAP 7.1 en Rust para Sintaxis y Semántica de los Lenguajes. Bajá el archivo de tu
sistema, descomprimilo y seguí `docs/integrations/` para conectarlo con ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code
o Codex, o abrí el editor con `rflap gui`.

Rflap is a modified version of JFLAP, distributed free of charge under the JFLAP 7.0 license
(see LICENSE). It is not endorsed by the JFLAP authors.
